data.name: Khaththab
data.long_meaning: The name Khaththab is derived from the Arabic root letters K.TH.TH. It means 'one who negotiates, settles disputes, or acts as an arbiter'. In Islamic history, Khaththab ibn Al-Mundhir was a prominent leader who negotiated treaties with the Jews and Christians of Medina, bringing peace and stability to the Islamic community.
